mapper.select: SELECT policy_code AS policyCode, rule_version AS ruleVersion, decision, actor_member_id AS actorMemberId FROM w17_reward_policy ORDER BY policy_code, rule_version LIMIT 500
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO w17_reward_policy(policy_code, rule_version, decision, actor_member_id) VALUES(#{policyCode}, #{ruleVersion}, #{decision}, #{actorMemberId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE decision = VALUES(decision), actor_member_id = VALUES(actor_member_id)
mapper.sql: v.version_id AS versionId, v.pledge_id AS pledgeId, v.version_no AS versionNo, v.quantity, v.service_start AS serviceStart, v.service_end AS serviceEnd, v.redeem_start AS redeemStart, v.redeem_end AS redeemEnd, v.terms, v.minor_restricted AS minorRestricted, v.rule_version AS ruleVersion, v.state, v.merchant_member_id AS merchantMemberId, v.merchant_confirmed_at AS merchantConfirmedAt, v.reviewer_member_id AS reviewerMemberId, v.frozen_at AS frozenAt, p.store_id AS storeId, p.coupon_id AS couponId, p.supply_ref AS supplyRef, p.state AS pledgeState
mapper.select: SELECT FROM w17_reward_pledge_version v JOIN w17_reward_pledge p ON p.pledge_id = v.pledge_id WHERE v.state = #{state}'CONFIRMED' AND p.store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY v.merchant_confirmed_at, v.version_id LIMIT 200
SELECT , v.payload_hash AS payloadHash FROM w17_reward_pledge_version v JOIN w17_reward_pledge p ON p.pledge_id = v.pledge_id WHERE v.version_id = #{versionId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT version_id FROM w17_reward_pledge_version WHERE pledge_id = #{pledgeId} ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE w17_reward_pledge_version SET state='REJECTED' WHERE version_id=#{versionId} AND state='CONFIRMED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO r10_reward_pledge_review_note(version_id, pledge_id, decision, note, sys_user_id, create_time) VALUES(#{versionId}, #{pledgeId}, #{decision}, #{note}, #{sysUserId}, NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT id, version_id AS versionId, pledge_id AS pledgeId, decision, note, sys_user_id AS sysUserId, create_time AS createTime FROM r10_reward_pledge_review_note WHERE pledge_id = #{pledgeId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100
